[issue by Sultia]
### Steps to Reproduce the Bug

Reproduceable steps: Place a creative motor down and attach shafts, then place a lot of belts connected to more shafts. Eventually after about 5 minutes or so of doing this, game crash.


### Expected Behavior

No game crash with such few mods that are suppose to have mod compatability.

### Actual Behavior

Game crash

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

N/A

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

N/A

### Extra Notes (Optional)

Working on a modpack I found a strange crash occurs with a certain mod combination. Sometimes when placing Create mod's belts this crash will occur. I will be reporting to every mod in the scenario to make sure at least one of them gets posted into the right place.

Mod list:
Architectury 13.0.8 (architectury)
Create 6.0.6 (create)
Create Goggles 6.1.1 (creategoggles)
